description: Somos estudantes de programação desenvolvendo o CtrlClima, uma plataforma que utiliza dados da NASA e de fontes confiáveis para analisar mudanças ambientais, investigar tendências de temperatura e identificar possíveis ondas de calor. Nosso objetivo é transformar dados científicos em visualizações claras, permitindo comparar informações por região e período e compreender melhor as mudanças climáticas.
summary:
CTRLClima is a web platform developed by the VulcanoDev team to investigate Earth system trends, focusing on temperature, precipitation, and land surface temperature. For the “Be an Earth System Trend Detective” challenge, it has integration code developed for NASA Giovanni and prepared for NASA AppEEARS, including the MODIS MOD11A2.061 product. The solution enables time-series investigation with exploratory linear regression and an illustrative five-year projection; it does not claim demonstrated statistical significance.
The interface provides context on the health risks of heat based on the World Health Organization and distinguishes air temperature from land surface temperature. It was developed using React, TypeScript, and NestJS. Accessibility features and support for Portuguese, English, and Spanish are included.
details:
1.         CONTEXT AND PROBLEM

 

Environmental variables measured by satellites and models vary over time and space. The same indicator may show different trends across regions, and seasonal fluctuations can make interpretation difficult. The challenge calls for selecting variables, obtaining observations for defined regions, building time series, estimating rates of change, and testing statistical significance.

CTRLClima aims to bring these steps together into an understandable investigative experience.

The social motivation includes making environmental changes understandable and providing context on the potential health effects of excessive heat. A temperature trend alone does not measure disease or demonstrate a causal relationship with a clinical outcome.

 

2. OBJECTIVES AND AUDIENCE

Overall objective: to develop a web interface for investigating environmental trends using traceable scientific data, accessible visualization, and transparent statistical analysis.

 

·     Select an environmental variable, a study region, and a time interval for which data are available.

·     Display historical time series with units, period, legend, region, and source.

·     Estimate trends using exploratory linear regression and present illustrative five-year projections, identifying the method and its limitations.

·     Distinguish exploratory trends, projections, and statistically validated analyses.

·     Explain known health effects of extreme heat using scientific references.
